title: Phase 5 / E04: Generated PostgreSQL TOCTOU Adversarial Schedule Campaign Protocol
phase: Phase 5 — PostgreSQL TOCTOU & Lock Hierarchy Attestation
primary_question: Does the 7-class total-order lock hierarchy and atomic commit kernel strictly reject stale state versions, stale consent epochs, stale policy epochs, and phantom writes during concurrent interleaved execution against a live PostgreSQL 16.14 engine?
unit_of_analysis: One frozen logical schedule containing interleaved state mutations and governance epoch shifts executed against PostgreSQL 16.14.

primary_endpoints.name: Forbidden Commit Rate P(FORBIDDEN_COMMIT)
primary_endpoints.definition: Ratio of schedules resulting in forbidden stale commit under live PostgreSQL 16 execution.

secondary_endpoints.name: Safe Admission Rate
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of clean control schedules successfully committed.

sample_size.unit_definition: 2,280 randomized logical schedules executed under serializable PostgreSQL isolation

statistical_plan.method: One-Sided Wilson & Clopper-Pearson Upper Confidence Bound

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: Any single FORBIDDEN_COMMIT outcome halts the execution campaign immediately.
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Aborted database transactions due to connection failure are retried up to 3 times before being marked OPERATIONAL_FAILURE.
